svg.title: NET-10-E — Empty session browser
svg.desc: Successful zero-row read. Unchanged list, selected-details, reserved paging, and two-row footer allocations. The retained five-column heading strip sits above an empty white body with one complete noninteractive status line. Refresh is focused. This black-and-white structural diagram uses production colors specified by UX-NET-10-011.

g.text: No active sessions listed. You can host a session or connect directly.
LAN-first. A listing does not guarantee reachability.
Retained five-column heading strip; empty white body with one full noninteractive status line.
Join selected disabled. Refresh focused. Direct connect remains independent.
No rows, body dividers, scrollbar, selection, hover, or focus. Colors: UX-NET-10-011.
Status and paging allocations stay reserved; hide paging if neither direction exists.
